vehicle. Repair that image in place.

they are. Two things may change, and only these two:

1. Artifacts to remove: white outline around the subject, cast shadow, halo, speckles.

   - erase the Renault diamond badge on the grille and on the tailgate

   - close every window with the same dark glass as the closed quarter windows

perspective, or the framing. Do not change a shape, a proportion, a colour, a material, or a wear
mark that is not named above. Do not add a part, a detail, or an accessory.

badge or a plate together with its screws, its outline, its shadow, and its recess: the surface
must read as one continuous painted panel. Leave no ghost rectangle, no smudge, no blurred patch,
and no invented replacement graphic. When a window is closed, give it the same material, the same
frame, and the same reflections as the other windows of the subject, and show no interior.

There is no ground and no environment. Keep the subject on a plain pure white background, with a
small even margin around it. Use no shadow, no reflection under the subject, no gradient, and no
vignette.
